findings.title: Materials' 60-point lens gap signals earnings bet
findings.body: Materials trades at 16.62x forward versus 36.79x trailing, a 60-point percentile gap between the two lenses. That is the market pricing in a 121 percent earnings surge, an aggressive assumption for a sector sitting at the 29th percentile of its own five-year range.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' forward price ignores trailing reality
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward P/E sits at the 27th percentile while its trailing multiple is at the 83rd, a 56-point gap. The market is paying a premium for future earnings growth that has not materialized yet, leaving the sector's valuation vulnerable if those estimates are revised down.

findings.title: Information Technology's percentile collapse outpaces multiple
findings.body: Information Technology's forward percentile dropped 13 points in a month to the 11th, yet its forward P/E of 21.67 remains above the S&P 500's 20.07. The sector is being repriced as if growth is slowing, but the multiple still commands a premium over the broad market, suggesting the de-rating has further to run.
